verdict.rationale: CrewAI documents Flows as "structured, event-driven workflows" that control execution, and GitHub promotes "event-driven control through Flows". Deployed crews can also be started externally through a REST kickoff endpoint, which lets outside systems trigger runs. However, the evidence never shows user-defined rules, condition syntax, or built-in triggers that fire actions automatically on external events; the webhook streaming feature sends events outward rather than listening for them. Missing for 10: documented rule/condition definitions, native external event triggers (e.g. app, email, or schedule events), and hands-on corroboration of event-triggered automation.
